title: Current Swift Package Manager and Swift Build
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of current swift package manager and swift build in a Swift program or workflow.
Apply swiftpm's package and build workflows in a small, inspectable example.
Check the expected result and identify one boundary case or platform constraint.

content.intro: This lesson focuses on current swift package manager and swift build and the practical choices around it. Start with the smallest example, connect it to “SwiftPM's package and build workflows”, and verify the result before adding complexity.
content.why_it_matters: Specialist paths and new language features depend on target support and toolchain details. Treat official documentation and reproducible checks as part of the solution.

content_blocks.title: Swift Package Layout
content_blocks.alt_text: The package diagram maps a manifest to source targets, products and a matching test target.
content_blocks.caption: A package separates products, targets, source and tests.

content_blocks.text: **Start with the rule.** Swift Package Manager describes products and targets in Package.swift. Pin or bound dependencies intentionally, review dependency changes, and use reproducible build/test commands.

**Work through the lesson.** Keep recent or version-sensitive topics separate from the core path and verify them against official Swift 6.4 material. The detailed subtopic list in this lesson preserves the curriculum coverage; treat each item as a cue for a small example or a focused question rather than trying to memorize syntax.
